# NAVA INTERIOR

> NAVA INTERIOR is a UAE interior fit-out, renovation and property maintenance company serving villas, apartments and offices in Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah and Ajman. One in-house team covers painting, gypsum false ceilings, wall moulding and panelling, carpentry and custom joinery, tile and marble, waterproofing, swimming pools, pergolas, AC, electrical and plumbing. Every project starts with a free inspection and a clear written quote, and work carries a 90-day workmanship warranty.

- Website: https://navainteriordubai.com/
- WhatsApp / phone: +971 56 752 2656
- Email: info@navainteriordubai.com
- Areas served: Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman
- Quotes: free inspection or quote from photos on WhatsApp; written quote before work starts

## Service areas
- [Dubai](https://navainteriordubai.com/areas/dubai/): From high-rise apartments in Dubai Marina and Downtown to family villas in Arabian Ranches and Dubai Hills, we handle repaints, false ceilings, wall moulding, joinery, bathroom and kitchen renovation, waterproofing, pools and AC. We work around building rules, book service lifts and handle the NOC paperwork most Dubai communities need.
- [Abu Dhabi](https://navainteriordubai.com/areas/abu-dhabi/): We serve apartments and villas across Abu Dhabi, including Al Reem, Saadiyat, Yas Island and Khalifa City, for interior fit-out, painting, ceilings, moulding, tiling and marble, waterproofing, pergolas and pool work, with the same in-house team and written quotes.
- [Sharjah](https://navainteriordubai.com/areas/sharjah/): In Sharjah we repaint and renovate apartments and villas, fit false ceilings and moulding, fix leaks and waterproof roofs and bathrooms, and service AC and water heaters.
- [Ajman](https://navainteriordubai.com/areas/ajman/): In Ajman we take on painting, gypsum ceilings, tiling, waterproofing, carpentry and full renovations for apartments, villas and shops.

## Interior fit-out & renovation
- [Apartment painting](https://navainteriordubai.com/services/apartment-painting/): Studio to 3-bed repaints, ceilings included. Move-in and move-out repaints that pass landlord checks.
- [Awnings & shade sails](https://navainteriordubai.com/services/awnings-and-shade-sails/): Retractable awnings, shade sails and car park shades for villas.
- [Balcony & terrace waterproofing](https://navainteriordubai.com/services/balcony-terrace-waterproofing/): Balconies, terraces and planters sealed against leaks and efflorescence.
- [Basement & foundation waterproofing](https://navainteriordubai.com/services/basement-waterproofing/): Dry basements and foundations with membranes, crystalline coatings and injection.
- [Bathroom & wet area waterproofing](https://navainteriordubai.com/services/bathroom-waterproofing/): Leak-proof bathrooms, showers and kitchens before tiling, so the neighbour's ceiling stays dry.
- [Bathroom renovation](https://navainteriordubai.com/services/bathroom-renovation/): Complete bathroom remodelling in Dubai: design, waterproofing, tiling, sanitaryware, vanity and glass, fully managed.
- [Bathroom tiling](https://navainteriordubai.com/services/bathroom-tiling/): Floor and wall tiling, large-format porcelain, mosaics and re-grouting.

## Technical & maintenance services
- [AC installation, repair & servicing](https://navainteriordubai.com/services/ac-repair/): Complete AC services: new installation, repair, gas refill, deep cleaning and annual maintenance for split, ducted and cassette units.
- [Annual maintenance contracts](https://navainteriordubai.com/services/annual-maintenance-contracts/): Scheduled AC, plumbing and electrical checks for apartments and villas, with priority call-outs.
- [Appliance repair](https://navainteriordubai.com/services/appliance-repair/): Washing machines, dryers, fridges, ovens and dishwashers repaired on site.
- [Bathroom refresh](https://navainteriordubai.com/services/bathroom-refresh/): Fast makeover without full renovation: re-grout, re-silicone, new fittings and paint.

- [Ceiling fans & exhaust fans](https://navainteriordubai.com/services/ceiling-fans-and-exhaust-fans/): Install or replace ceiling, bathroom and kitchen exhaust fans.
- [Chandelier & light installation](https://navainteriordubai.com/services/chandelier-installation/): Chandeliers, LED ring pendants and ceiling lights hung safely, levelled and wired to switch or remote.
- [Crack & leak injection](https://navainteriordubai.com/services/crack-leak-injection/): PU and epoxy injection to stop active leaks through concrete cracks and joints.
